'''Barrysneverwrong TIE: Time for Immense Evil''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Barrysneverwrong]]
* '''Published:''' 5 June 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: Central Core|Premiere-D-deathstarcentralcore.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star: Central Core
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Death Star Central Core Barrysnever.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is my very first dark side deck, so I need some help with it, please make any suggestions; especially for the characters, but do not change

== Strategy ==

The strategy of this deck is to get characters out to death star sites; none of which rebels can deploy to as there are no force icons (except docking bay, which i usually dont deploy) and to pile TIES onto alderran, then take advantage of its game text, moving the dreadnaughts to take out any pesky starfighters. Again the characters need work, and if you can suggest an objective to go with these please do, I need the help!
